text:
```yaml
name: Mutation Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  infection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '8.2'
        extensions: dom, intl, opcache, pcntl, pdo_mysql, simplexml, xmlreader, xsl

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader

    - name: Run mutation testing
      run: vendor/bin/infection --min-msi=80 --min-covered-msi=85 --exclude=src-deprecated

    - name: Commit results
      uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
      with:
        add: 'mutation-results/'
        commit: 'Update mutation testing results'
        author_name: GitHub Actions
        author_email: actions@github.com
        cwd: '.'
        message: 'Automated mutation testing results update'
```
